FN-XD8H477-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 72
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/24/2025
Senate Bill 72 as introduced would allow the Alabama Medical Cannabis Commission to issue
two additional integrated facility licenses which would increase receipts to the Commission by
$100,000 annually. This bill would also increase the obligations of the Commission by an
undetermined amount by requiring the Commission to hire a nationally recognized consultant
with expertise in financial auditing to evaluate and select applicants for the integrated facility
licenses. Further, this bill would also save the Commission an estimated minimum of $20,000
per hearing held by removing the requirement to hold a public investigative hearing upon the
request of the applicant after the denial of a license.

FN-XD8H477-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 72
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 03/19/2025
Senate Bill 72 as reported by the Committee on Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry would
allow the Alabama Medical Cannabis Commission to issue two additional integrated facility
licenses which would increase receipts to the Commission by $100,000 annually. This bill
would also increase the obligations of the Commission by an undetermined amount to pay the
cost of a nationally recognized consultant with expertise in financial auditing and selected by the
Chief Examiner of the Department of Examiners of Public Accounts in consultation with the
Director of Finance and the State Health Officer, to evaluate and select applicants for the
integrated facility licenses. Further, this bill would also save the Commission an estimated
minimum of $20,000 per hearing held by removing the requirement to hold a public
investigative hearing upon the request of the applicant after the denial of a license.
